title: Senior Specialist - Application Security
description:
It's about Being What's next.
 **What's in it for you?**

 The Senior Specialist in this position will enterprise application security SME – VAPT of Web, API, Android and iOS and manager end\-to\-end VAPT – planning, execution, reporting, remediation and retesting. Along with vulnerability management – triage, prioritisation, ownership and risk\-based closure and security assurance across design, development, deployment and production support.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  


 Making an impact.
 **What will you do?**

* The Senior Specialist in this position will lead end\-to\-end VAPT for web applications, APIs, Android and iOS using manual and automated techniques
* You will also define assessment scope, test strategy, attack scenarios and rules of engagement
* Apply OWASP, CWE, CVSS and relevant NIST guidance throughout assessments
* Validating exploitability, business impact and root cause; eliminate false positives
* You will also quality\-assure findings for severity, evidence, reproducibility, remediation and reporting accuracy
* And manage UVM intake and triage – validation, deduplication, ownership, prioritisation and SLA tracking
* Also, assess patch and remediation options – applicability, dependencies, implementation risk and compensating controls
* Provide remediation guidance covering secure code, configuration, dependency upgrades, patching and architectural controls
* Along with performing retesting, residual\-risk assessment, verified closure and exception/risk\-acceptance support
* Also, maintain evidence, audit traceability, metrics, dashboards and management reporting
* Support threat modelling, security architecture, secure\-design and pre\-production reviews
* Review and correlate SAST, DAST, SCA and cloud/container security findings
* You will develop reusable testing methodologies, checklists, scripts and automation
* And mentor engineers; lead technical reviews, stakeholder discussions and complex security escalations



 Winning in your role.

* Bachelor’s degree – Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or equivalent
* Preferred certifications – OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GWAPT, GMOB or equivalent hands\-on offensive\-security credential
* 5\+ years – hands\-on application security, web/API/mobile VAPT and vulnerability management
* Knowledge on OWASP WSTG, Top 10, API Security Top 10, MASVS/MASTG, CWE and CVSS and Burp Suite Professional, Acunetix, Kali Linux, Nmap, Metasploit and sqlmap is a must
* Also, Knowledge on HTTP/S, REST, SOAP, GraphQL, XML, JSON and web services

 Support infrastructure resilience, disaster recovery, and recovery readiness initiatives across compute, storage, backup, virtualization, cloud, and hybrid environments. * Conduct resilience assessments across compute, storage, backup, virtualization, cloud, identity, and network services.
* Evaluate recovery strategies, dependency mappings, recovery sequencing, and recovery readiness.
* Execute DR tests, failover/failback exercises, recovery simulations, and validation activities.
* Assess backup and storage environments for recovery readiness, replication, immutability, retention, and RPO/RTO alignment.
* Develop and maintain DR plans, recovery runbooks, and recovery procedures.

* Identify resilience gaps, recovery risks, and SPOFs, and provide remediation recommendations.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, operations, application, audit, and business teams.

* Experience with backup technologies, replication, snapshots, immutable backups, retention, and restore processes.
* Knowledge of networking concepts including LAN, WAN, redundancy, failover, and load balancing.
* Experience with DR planning, recovery testing, failover/failback, dependency mapping, and recovery validation.
* Understanding of ransomware recovery, trusted restores, and recovery preparedness.
* Strong documentation, analytical, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
* Understanding of hosting models, cloud platforms, and datacenter strategies.


**Good to Have**
* Exposure to AI/GenAI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven resilience solutions.
* Knowledge of Python, PowerShell, or automation scripting.

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Azure, AWS, VMware VCP, or similar infrastructure certifications preferred.
* Experience supporting infrastructure transformation, resilience, or DR programs.

* Ability to independently manage assessment and testing activities.

* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and client\-facing skills.

title: Product Security Lead
description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Role**
 As an Assistant Product Security Manager / Security Master at Ericsson, you will work with the E5GC (Enterprise 5G Connect) Product Security Manager (PSM) to support the E5GC development organization in India. You will help embed security and privacy throughout the product lifecycle, from solution design and development through testing, vulnerability handling, compliance, delivery, and support.
   

  

 The role is suited to a proactive, self\-starting security professional who combines technical expertise, practical judgment, clear communication, and creative problem\-solving.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the E5GC PSM in implementing product\-security processes across the India development organization and integrating security into development and delivery practices.
* Monitor and coordinate responses to PSIRT alerts, vulnerabilities, and security incidents, including triage, CVSS\-based risk assessment, remediation tracking, verification, and escalation.
* Coordinate penetration testing and vulnerability assessments, including scope definition, findings analysis, remediation follow\-up, and closure.
* Support the selection, implementation, and effective use of security tools, automation, and responsible AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Provide security and privacy input to solution design, including applicable security and privacy GPRs, threat modeling, secure design, and personal\-data protection requirements.
* Assist with security and privacy Statements of Compliance, audits, risk assessments, evidence preparation, and other governance activities.
* Prepare and maintain security documentation, including security assessments, test reports, and vulnerability records.
* Advise and collaborate with developers, architects, product managers, privacy specialists, and other stakeholders on secure implementation, risk reduction, and continuous improvement.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in cybersecurity, information security, computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in product security, application security, cybersecurity, vulnerability management, penetration testing, or a related area.
* Practical experience with CVSS, vulnerability testing and handling, penetration\-testing findings, remediation coordination, and risk\-based prioritization.
* Experience responding to security advisories, PSIRT alerts, vulnerability disclosures, or security incidents.
* Experience implementing or operationalizing security tools in a software\-development environment.
* Knowledge of secure software development, security architecture, threat modeling, security\-by\-design, and personal\-data protection.
* Knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 and information\-security management practices.
* Familiarity with security and privacy compliance, Statements of Compliance, audits, and evidence preparation.
* Familiarity with vulnerability scanners, software\-composition analysis, static and dynamic analysis, container security, or cloud\-security tools.
* Experience using scripting, automation, data analysis, or AI to improve security workflows.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across cultures and functions.


**Personal competencies**
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and comfortable taking ownership from identification through resolution.
* An out\-of\-the\-box thinker who can develop practical solutions to security and privacy challenges.
* Analytical, structured, detail\-oriented, and able to make sound risk\-based decisions.
* Collaborative, adaptable, curious, and confident raising security and privacy concerns constructively.
* Able to balance delivery needs with security, privacy, compliance, and customer expectations.


**Success in this role**
 Success means providing timely and practical security guidance to the India development organization, ensuring PSIRT alerts and vulnerabilities are handled effectively, and strengthening the E5GC security and privacy posture through better design, testing, tools, documentation, and collaboration.

**People \& Team Leadership**

* Build high\-performing, diverse teams with a focus on technical excellence and client empathy.
* Drive utilization, training, and career development.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI technologies and their application in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.
* Familiarity with secure AI adoption practices, including governance, model lifecycle security, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, research, or open\-source initiatives in application security.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST SSDF).
* Executive presence — ability to influence CxOs and translate complex technical risks into business outcomes.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE / B.Tech / MCA.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of experience in application security, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, or security architecture.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Prior experience in a Big 4 or similar consulting environment as a Manager / Senior Manager.

We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
